plain_summary_en: This paper studies How Healthcare Professionals in an Acute Hospital Setting Use Accounts to Avoid, De-Escalate or Resolve the Distress of People Living with Dementia. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is How, Healthcare, Professionals, Acute. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
